description: This PHP script initializes and renders a web page for managing request systems within the TestLink project. It loads configuration, initializes objects, retrieves data, and displays it using a Smarty template. It also includes functions for session handling and access rights checks.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns arguments and session data needed for the page.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if a user has rights to view or manage request systems.
